verse.verse_6: Indeed, the human is ungrateful to his Lord.
verse.verse_7: To this he himself shall bear witness.
verse.verse_8: And indeed he is ardent for the love of good (wealth, becoming greedy).
verse.verse_9: Does he not know that when that which is in the graves is overthrown,
verse.verse_10: and that which is in the chest is brought out,
verse.verse_11: indeed, on that Day their Lord will be aware of them!
